+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_cause", [True, False])
+async def test_application_exception_preserves_context(explicit_cause: bool) -> None:
+    cause = LookupError("cause")
+
+    async def endpoint(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        try:
+            raise cause
+        except LookupError as exc:
+            if explicit_cause:
+                raise RuntimeError("application") from exc
+            raise RuntimeError("application")
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    app = BaseHTTPMiddleware(endpoint, dispatch=passthrough)
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "http.request", "body": b"", "more_body": False}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="application") as exc_info:
+        await app({"type": "http", "method": "GET", "path": "/", "headers": []}, receive, send)
+
+    assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is cause
+
+
